thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Retrofit go-live dry run scheduled Wed 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. Need quota plan, autoscale targets, and a 30m loadtest window. Can we align?
jon_devops: On it. How many GPUs committed? Contract says 8xA100 reserved but customer expects burst to 12 — need to confirm slots.
maria_cs: Contract shows 8 reserved, +burst to 12 allowed. Ops, is burst auto or manual?
linus_sre: Burst is autoscale (auto). Current cooldown 5m by default. Recommendation: max_instances=12, target_util=0.7, pin model route to v2.1 for stability.
tara_oncall: Agree with target_util. For loadtests: steady ramp 0->100 RPS over 10m, hold 15m, then step-down. Also run a 10m canary first.
jon_devops: I'll upload load scripts to s3: s3://redwood-loadtests/retrofit/2026-03-31.tar.gz — will include a k6 scenario. Example run: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 25m loadscript.js`
maria_cs: Make sure token cache priming is part of the prep — customer uses long-form chat flows so KV cache priming matters.
linus_sre: Good call. I'll add a priming pass: 50 warmup sessions hitting prefix endpoints and enable KV cache on the model route.
jon_devops: Autoscale config draft (snippet):
```
max_instances: 12
min_instances: 3
scale_metric: avg_gpu_usage
target: 0.7
cooldown: 300s
```
I'll post this as an infra PR.
maria_cs: Add quota safety checks: if reserved pool usage >90% for >10m, throttle new onramps and send paging alert to ops.
ops_bot: Reminder: runbook 'dedicated-onramp' updated — https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-onramp (see section 3.2 for burst handling).
tara_oncall: :thumbsup: I'll own the 10:45 canary window and monitor p50/p95/p99 latency and error rates. Ping me 5m before the start.
jon_devops: Can someone share the expected traffic profile? I have a rough: peaks ~350 RPS daytime, median ~85. We should simulate 1.2x peak for safety.
maria_cs: Sending the exact profile in a DM. Also please capture token-level cost metrics and per-route p95 latency during the test.
linus_sre: We'll add tracing and cost tags on the route, and include a quick regression check. Postmortem template is ready if needed.
jon_devops: PR opened: https://git.internal/infracode/retrofit-autoscale/123 — assigning to @linus_sre for review.
tara_oncall: Noted. If the run trips the quotas or latency spikes, fallback plan is to route heavy requests to hosted model v2.0 with degraded perf.
maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll update the customer-facing runbook, confirm the 10:00 PT slot with Retrofit, and close coordination once PR merged.
